name: liborigin
desc: Library for reading OriginLab OPJ project files
why: Reverse-engineered reader for OriginLab's closed binary project format, a neat window into proprietary file structure, though a library at heart.

brief.what_it_is: liborigin is a C++ library for reading OriginLab OPJ project files. The SourceForge homepage's only project description is the one-line tagline "A library for reading OriginLab OPJ project files." The page does not describe what comes out of the reader. The Homebrew metadata lists an executable called opj2dat, but the page does not describe what it does, so the output format is unverified.
brief.why_it_exists: The homepage gives no problem statement or author framing beyond the tagline. The scout note calls it a reverse-engineered reader for OriginLab's closed binary project format, but I could not confirm that from anything the page says.
brief.install_notes: Nothing beyond the Homebrew formula was visible. The SourceForge page lists a Download button and files, but I did not find install steps, dependencies, or build instructions in the pages I fetched.
brief.standout: Based on the scout note, it is a third-party reader for a closed binary format that OriginLab does not document. I could not verify that from the pages, so treat the claim as unconfirmed.
brief.status: Beta, per the SourceForge status field. The page shows Last Update 2026-07-09, registered 2005-09-02, and 77 downloads this week. Three maintainers are listed (gbmiquel, gerlachs, knut_f). Recent activity suggests it is maintained, but I found no release notes or commit log to confirm it.
brief.caveats: The SourceForge page had almost no project content: no README text, no docs, no commands, and no install steps. The homepage was reachable, but the README was not. The pages I fetched contained unrelated SourceForge sidebar material such as ads and recommended projects, which I ignored. The license is GPLv2 per the page. Build requirements and platform support are unknown.
quotes: A library for reading OriginLab OPJ project files.
